test_cases.scenario: Login page loads for unauthenticated user
test_cases.steps: Ensure setup is complete. Log out if logged in. Navigate to /login/.
test_cases.expected: Page loads. Login form is visible. No errors in the browser console.

test_cases.scenario: CSRF cookie is set on page load
test_cases.steps: Navigate to GET /login/. Open browser DevTools > Application > Cookies.
test_cases.expected: A csrftoken cookie is present after the page loads.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user is redirected away from the login page
test_cases.steps: Log in successfully. Then navigate directly to /login/.
test_cases.expected: User is immediately redirected to /dashboard/. The login form is not shown.

test_cases.scenario: App branding and name render correctly on the login page
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/ after setup with a custom app name.
test_cases.expected: The configured app name and branding appear correctly. Theme is applied.

test_cases.scenario: Classic login form is visible when AUTH_MODE is classic
test_cases.steps: Configure AUTH_MODE=classic in setup. Navigate to /login/.
test_cases.expected: Email and password input fields and a Sign In button are visible.

test_cases.scenario: Password field is masked by default
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/. Observe the password input field.
test_cases.expected: Password characters are obscured (input type=password).

test_cases.scenario: Forgot password link is present on the login page
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/.
test_cases.expected: A 'Forgot password?' or equivalent link is visible and navigates to /forgot-password/.

test_cases.scenario: Register link is visible when self-registration is enabled
test_cases.steps: Configure AUTH_MODE=classic and ALLOW_REGISTRATION=true. Navigate to /login/.
test_cases.expected: A link to register (e.g. 'Create account') is visible on the login page.

test_cases.scenario: Valid credentials establish a session and redirect to the dashboard
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/. Enter the admin email and correct password. Click Sign In.
test_cases.expected: User is redirected to /dashboard/. Session cookie is set. User is authenticated.

test_cases.scenario: Superuser can log in via classic login regardless of AUTH_MODE
test_cases.steps: Set AUTH_MODE to non-classic (e.g. oauth). Navigate to /login/ as the superuser created during setup. Enter correct credentials.
test_cases.expected: Superuser is authenticated and redirected successfully. No 403 error.

test_cases.scenario: Session cookie is present after successful login
test_cases.steps: Complete a successful login. Open browser DevTools > Application > Cookies.
test_cases.expected: A session cookie (sessionid) is set for the domain.

test_cases.scenario: Submit button shows loading state during request
test_cases.steps: Enter valid credentials. Click Sign In. Observe the button immediately after clicking.
test_cases.expected: Button is disabled and shows a loading indicator while the request is in-flight.

test_cases.scenario: Invalid password returns an error
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/. Enter a valid email but wrong password. Click Sign In.
test_cases.expected: 401 error. An error message is shown (e.g. 'Invalid email or password'). No session established.

test_cases.scenario: Non-existent email returns the same generic error as wrong password
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/. Enter an email that does not exist in the system. Click Sign In.
test_cases.expected: Same error message as an invalid password (e.g. 'Invalid email or password'). No user enumeration.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivated user account returns a 403 error
test_cases.steps: Deactivate a user account. Navigate to /login/. Enter that user's credentials. Click Sign In.
test_cases.expected: 403 error. Message indicates the account has been deactivated. No session established.

test_cases.scenario: Classic login is blocked for non-superusers when AUTH_MODE is not classic
test_cases.steps: Set AUTH_MODE=oauth. Navigate to /login/ as a regular (non-superuser) user. Enter correct credentials.
test_cases.expected: 403 error. Message indicates classic login is not enabled.

test_cases.scenario: Error message is displayed inline without a full page reload
test_cases.steps: Enter invalid credentials. Click Sign In.
test_cases.expected: Error is shown inline on the form. The URL does not change. The form is still usable.

test_cases.scenario: Empty email field shows a validation error
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/. Leave email empty. Enter a password. Click Sign In.
test_cases.expected: Validation error for the email field. Form is not submitted.

test_cases.scenario: Invalid email format shows a validation error
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/. Enter 'notanemail' in the email field. Click Sign In.
test_cases.expected: Validation error indicating invalid email format.

test_cases.scenario: Empty password field shows a validation error
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/. Enter a valid email. Leave password empty. Click Sign In.
test_cases.expected: Validation error for the password field. Form is not submitted.

test_cases.scenario: Both fields empty shows validation errors for both
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/. Leave all fields empty. Click Sign In.
test_cases.expected: Both email and password fields show validation errors.

test_cases.scenario: Error messages do not reveal whether an email address exists
test_cases.steps: Attempt login with a non-existent email. Attempt login with an existing email but wrong password. Compare the error messages.
test_cases.expected: Both attempts return the same error message. User enumeration is not possible.

test_cases.scenario: Login API response does not expose sensitive user data
test_cases.steps: Inspect the network response for a successful and a failed login attempt.
test_cases.expected: No passwords, hashes, tokens, or internal IDs are returned in the API response body.

test_cases.scenario: CSRF protection is enforced on the login endpoint
test_cases.steps: Attempt to POST to /api/v1/auth/login/ without a valid CSRF token (e.g. using curl).
test_cases.expected: Request is rejected with a 403 Forbidden error.

test_cases.scenario: Login page renders correctly on mobile screen sizes
test_cases.steps: Open /login/ in a browser. Resize window to 375×812px (or use mobile emulation). Observe layout.
test_cases.expected: Form is fully visible and usable. No overflow or broken layout.

test_cases.scenario: Login form is accessible via keyboard navigation
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/. Use Tab key to move through fields and Enter to submit.
test_cases.expected: All form fields, the Sign In button, and the forgot password link are reachable via keyboard.

test_cases.scenario: Form fields have accessible labels
test_cases.steps: Inspect the login form HTML. Check that email and password inputs have associated labels or aria-label attributes.
test_cases.expected: Each input field has a visible or accessible label. No unlabelled form controls.
